mapper.insert: insert into participation ( project_id, member_id, want_position, motive, experience, project_role, join_status, applied_at ) values ( #{projectId}, #{memberId}, #{wantPosition}, #{motive}, #{experience}, 'MEMBER', 'WAITING', NOW() )
mapper.select: select p.*, m.name as member_name from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id where p.project_id = #{projectId} and p.project_role = 'MEMBER' and p.join_status = 'WAITING' order by p.applied_at DESC

select p.*, pr.title, pr.category, pr.status from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id join project pr on p.project_id = pr.project_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.join_status = 'JOINED' and pr.status != 'DONE' order by p.applied_at DESC limit #{limit}

select p.*, pr.title, pr.category, pr.status from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id join project pr on p.project_id = pr.project_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} and (p.join_status = 'WAITING' or p.join_status = 'INTERVIEW' or p.join_status = 'REJECTED') and pr.status != 'DONE' order by p.applied_at DESC limit #{limit}

select p.*, pr.title, pr.category, pr.status from participation p join member m on p.member_id = m.member_id join project pr on p.project_id = pr.project_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} and pr.status = 'DONE' order by p.applied_at DESC limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM participation WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
SELECT p.part_id, p.project_id, p.member_id, p.project_role, p.join_status, p.succession_order, p.contribution, p.applied_at, m.name AS member_name, m.major AS member_major
FROM participation p
INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id
WHERE p.project_id = #{project_id} AND p.join_status = 'JOINED' AND p.project_role IN ('LEADER', 'MEMBER')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.project_role = 'LEADER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.name ASC
SELECT project_role FROM participation WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role IN ('LEADER', 'MEMBER', 'MENTOR') LIMIT 1

SELECT p.part_id, p.project_id, p.member_id, p.project_role, p.join_status, p.succession_order, p.contribution, p.applied_at, p.want_position, m.name AS member_name, m.major AS member_major, m.grade AS member_grade FROM participation p INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.join_status = 'JOINED' AND p.project_role IN ('LEADER', 'MEMBER', 'MENTOR') ORDER BY CASE p.project_role WHEN 'MENTOR' THEN 0 WHEN 'LEADER' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN p.succession_order IS NULL OR p.succession_order <= 0 THEN 2147483647 ELSE p.succession_order END, m.name ASC

SELECT p.part_id, p.project_id, p.member_id, p.project_role, p.join_status, p.applied_at, p.want_position, p.motive, p.experience, m.name AS member_name, m.major AS member_major, m.grade AS member_grade FROM participation p INNER JOIN member m ON m.member_id = p.member_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.join_status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY p.applied_at ASC, p.part_id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(succession_order), 0) + 1 FROM participation WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role = 'MEMBER'
mapper.update: UPDATE participation SET join_status = 'REJECTED', project_role = 'MEMBER', succession_order = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND join_status = 'WAITING'
UPDATE participation SET join_status = 'BANISH', succession_order = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role = 'MEMBER'
mapper.select: SELECT part_id, project_id, member_id, project_role, join_status, succession_order FROM participation WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role = 'MEMBER' ORDER BY CASE WHEN succession_order IS NULL OR succession_order <= 0 THEN 2147483647 ELSE succession_order END, part_id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE participation SET join_status = 'BANISH', succession_order = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role = 'LEADER'
UPDATE participation SET project_role = 'LEADER', succession_order = NULL WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND join_status = 'JOINED' AND project_role = 'MEMBER'
